notes: Seeded from a research pass on 12 Oct 2026. Each venue was confirmed open via a dated 2026 listing or 2026 news (see status_evidence).
Official website URLs were not all fetched individually; the venue profiler should confirm them on its first run.
Scouts may read this file but must not edit it. Suggested changes go in the run report for a human to apply.
A venue with no_primary_listing: true has no venue or ticket page online; the verifier may publish its events on aggregator evidence alone.

Platform 'domains' are enforced by scripts/validate.py and scripts/check_quote.py: do-not-use and do-not-scrape domains are never fetched or accepted as evidence; discovery-only domains can never be labelled primary.

zones.core: E2 postcode or within about 1km of Bethnal Green tube. Scanned every run.
zones.fringe: Up to about a 20-minute walk (1.6km) from Bethnal Green tube. Scanned every run.
zones.outer: Further out (Dalston, Hackney Central, Hackney Wick, west Shoreditch, Clapton). Scanned weekly, standout nights only, max 5 candidates per run, flagged worth_the_trip.

platforms.name: Resident Advisor (ra.co)
platforms.why: No public API. Terms 4.4 ban automated extraction without written permission; robots.txt blocks ClaudeBot. Do not fetch, do not use third-party RA scrapers.

platforms.name: DICE
platforms.how: Read public dice.fm event and venue pages one at a time. Check robots.txt at the start of each run and stop if disallowed. The Partners API needs a venue or promoter to grant access, so it is only an option if a venue partners with us.

platforms.name: Ticket Tailor
platforms.how: Read public box-office pages, e.g. tickettailor.com/events/<box-office>. The API key is per box office, so it is only available if the venue gives us one.

platforms.name: Skiddle
platforms.how: GET /api/v1/events/search/ with latitude, longitude, radius (miles), eventcode (CLUB, LIVE, LGB, BARPUB) and minDate. Key in env SKIDDLE_API_KEY. If the key is missing, skip silently.
platforms.blocker: Free key is non-commercial unless Skiddle approves in writing. Apply and confirm before relying on it.

platforms.name: Eventbrite
platforms.how: Location search was shut off in 2020. Only list events by organiser or venue id stored on a venue below. Key in env EVENTBRITE_TOKEN.

platforms.name: OutSavvy
platforms.how: Public event pages, mostly queer events. Read the specific event page.

platforms.name: Songkick
platforms.how: Good for spotting gigs, but it is an aggregator. Use it to find leads, then confirm on the venue or ticket page. Never the only evidence for a high-confidence candidate. Light reads only; review its terms before scaling up.

platforms.name: ma.to
platforms.how: Venue pages list DJ nights for several pubs and bars. Leads only; confirm on a primary page where one exists. If the venue has no other listing (e.g. Star of Bethnal Green), keep it at medium confidence at most.

platforms.name: Instagram
platforms.how: Not fetched by agents. Events seen there arrive as reader tips or manual entries.
